howto_modal.at_the_end_of_your: At the end of your turn, you get new dice. You get dice based on your biggest connected territories amount. Like if you have 4 territories, but only 3 are adjacent, you get 3 dice.
howto_modal.attack_time_time_limit_in: Attack Time: Time limit in seconds for each individual attack. Unlimited by default.
howto_modal.attacks_limits_how_many_atta: Attacks: Limits how many attacks a player can make per turn. Unlimited by default.
howto_modal.autoplay_human_players_are_s: Autoplay: Human players are switched to autoplay and the game finishes automatically.
howto_modal.beginner_full_animations_amp: Beginner: Full animations & dice rolls. Win chances & input hints shown. Slow bot turns.
howto_modal.choose_how_challenging_the: Choose how challenging the AI opponents are. Set per-bot in the player roster.
howto_modal.classic_attacker_must_roll_s: Classic: Attacker must roll strictly higher to win. Ties go to the defender.
howto_modal.classic_players_take_turns_o: Classic: Players take turns one at a time. Only the active player can attack.
howto_modal.classic_the_die_is_redirecte: Classic: The die is redirected to another non-full territory; if all are full it goes to the stack for next turn.
howto_modal.controls_how_fast_the: Controls how fast the game plays. Can be changed anytime in Pause or Settings.
howto_modal.dice_attack_dice_your_attack: Dice attack dice. Your attack power is the sum of all your dice values. Highest sum wins.
howto_modal.dice_sides_sides_per_die: Dice Sides: Sides per die. Higher sides increase variance; D1 makes all dice equal.
howto_modal.easy_attack_attacker_wins_on: Easy Attack: Attacker wins on a tie as well as a higher roll.
howto_modal.easy_targets_bots_first_make: Easy: Targets bots first. Makes mistakes. Good for learning the game. Player starts first.
howto_modal.expert_no_animations_no_win: Expert: No animations. No win chances. One-click attack shortcut. Instant bot turns.
howto_modal.full_reinforcements_are_plac: Full: Reinforcements are placed randomly across all territories. If the chosen territory is full, that die is lost.
howto_modal.game_mode_variant_rules_for: Game Mode: Variant rules for how the map is populated at game start.
howto_modal.hard_same_as_medium_but: Hard: Same as medium but plans attacks more strategically: focuses on the strongest player, breaks enemy connected regions to cut their reinforcements, and consolidates its own territory. Player starts last.
howto_modal.how_ties_are_resolved_when: How ties are resolved when both sides roll the same total:
howto_modal.if_you_have_a_higher: If you have a higher total than the defender, you win. You take over the territory and move your dice there (leaving 1 behind).
howto_modal.if_you_have_equal_or: If you have equal or fewer points, you lose. Your dice count drops to 1 and your turn ends immediately.
howto_modal.largest_region_the_player_wi: Largest Region: The player with the biggest single connected region wins.
howto_modal.map_style_shape_of_the: Map Style: Shape of the generated map (Full, Balanced, Islands, etc.).
howto_modal.max_dice_4_the_conquering: Max Dice +4: The conquering player's max dice cap is raised by 4 and the game continues.
howto_modal.max_dice_per_territory_the: Max Dice per Territory: The maximum number of dice that can stack on a single tile.
howto_modal.medium_attacks_anyone_equall: Medium: Attacks anyone equally. Prefers a dice advantage of 2 or more and plays a bit more aggressive.
howto_modal.no_stack_redirected_to_a: No Stack: Redirected to a non-full territory as usual, but excess dice are lost instead of stacking.
howto_modal.normal_faster_animations_win: Normal: Faster animations. Win chances shown. Fast bot turns.
howto_modal.objective_conquer_all_tiles_: OBJECTIVE: Conquer all tiles of the grid.
howto_modal.parallel_every_player_human_: Parallel: Every player (human and bot) can attack at any time simultaneously.
howto_modal.parallel_s_like_parallel_but: Parallel S: Like Parallel, but the currently active player is safe from bot attacks.
howto_modal.random_tile_a_random_tile: Random Tile: A random tile is picked; its owner wins.
howto_modal.reborn_like_no_stack_hard: Reborn: Like No Stack Hard, but if the chosen territory is full it resets to 1 die instead of the die being lost.
howto_modal.select_dice_sides_to_see: Select dice sides to see win probability when attacking.
howto_modal.territories_the_player_with_: Territories: The player with the most territories wins instead.
howto_modal.tie_die_on_a_tie: Tie Die: On a tie, both territories drop to 1 die and no territory changes hands.
howto_modal.turn_limit_if_no_player: TURN LIMIT: If no player conquers all territories within 999 turns, the game ends and the player with the most total dice (on the board + in reserve) wins.
howto_modal.turn_time_time_limit_in: Turn Time: Time limit in seconds for an entire turn. Unlimited by default.
howto_modal.what_happens_when_a_reinforc: What happens when a reinforcement die lands on a territory already at max dice:
howto_modal.what_happens_when_the_board: What happens when the board is completely filled by a single player:
howto_modal.when_editing_maps_or: When editing maps or scenarios, controls change:

tutorial.combat_explain: All dice are rolled and added together. If the attacker has a higher total than the defender, the attacker takes over the territory and moves their dice there (leaving 1 behind).
tutorial.end_turn_explain: When you're done attacking, press End Turn. You get bonus dice. They are equal to the size of your largest connected region of tiles.
tutorial.hint_attack: Click your tile, then click an enemy tile to attack.
tutorial.hint_lose: If the attacker has equal or fewer points, he loses. His dice count drops to 1 and his turn ends immediately.
tutorial.speed_reminder: On bigger maps, animations can take a while. Once you're comfortable with the basics, we recommend Normal or Expert speed. You can change this anytime in Pause or Settings.
tutorial.welcome: Welcome to Diception! Your goal is to conquer every tile on the board.
